name: frequency-fresh-confirmation-iid-release-20260928
purpose: Append-only evidence for pre-outcome whole-cohort IID protocol amendment and conditionally authorized release; not an execution result.

authorization.scope: All ten existing reserved families, unchanged source/schema/targets/methods/learners/budget; release only after explicit binding validates.

amendment.name: three-fold-iid
amendment.timing: Before any payload or outcome inspection for this cohort; resolves the documented six-per-test-class versus minimum-ten contradiction without dropping families or lowering thresholds.
amendment.description: All ten datasets receive new three-fold IID experimental evaluation. Classification is stratified; regression uses the existing seeded IID splitter. OpenML task IDs/data versions and complete source official split integrity checks remain unchanged. Explicit top-level preregistration.resplit_official_as_iid=true is required and constrains the whole plan to three-fold IID; no per-entry override or implicit default replacement is permitted.
amendment.metadata_expectation: The smallest reported class is60; stratified three-fold splits would give20 test and40 train records for it. This is a metadata expectation, not proof of actual payload counts, numeric validity or nested-model completion.
amendment.no_outcome_based_changes: No substitutions, exclusions, target recoding, schema changes, row caps, method/learner switches or performance-driven fold selection.
